messages:
Alex: Nightly h100 warmup failing in nightly/gpu-smoke (job 7421). Logs show cuDNN version mismatch warning + warmup OOM. Can someone triage? @Jess @ML-OnCall

Jess: Can you paste the top of the log + the container image tag? quick glance helps.

Alex: job link: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/7421

Alex: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16 03:12:21] WARN cuDNN: loaded cuDNN 8.6, expected 8.8
[2026-03-16 03:12:21] ERROR CUDNN_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED: conv_forward
[2026-03-16 03:12:23] OOM when allocating 1.2GiB for KVCACHE
libcuda.so.1: cannot map executable stack
```

Dmitri: That "loaded 8.6 expected 8.8" screams image/template drift. Which image hash is this?

Alex: image: ghcr.io/redwood/runtime/nightly:cuda12.2-cudnn8.8@sha256:abc123def

Marta: If the image tag says cudnn8.8 but loaded 8.6, maybe the host has older drivers or ldconfig mismatch. Try ldd on /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcudnn.so.8 in the job.

Sam: Quick action: ML-OnCall can you rerun job 7421 with --node h100-stable (pinned kernel/driver) to see if it's infra noise? If it passes, then it's infra. If not, bisect images.

ML-OnCall: On it. Requeued -> https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/7421/retry

Jess: Also try forcing CONTAINER_CUDNN_OVERRIDE=8.6 to see if the binary is compatible. If that fails it's real incompat.

Dmitri: Suggest running two quick repros: previous nightly 7419 and current 7421; compare image digest and host driver (nvidia-smi -a). I can help with bisect tomorrow.

Alex: Thanks. I'll hold off merge on the PR that pulled the new base image. Alex: tagging this thread for follow-up once rerun completes :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Job 7421 retry finished: FAILED (warmup OOM). Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/7421/logs

ML-OnCall: OK it failed again. I grabbed nvidia-smi from node: Driver 535.54, CUDA 12.2, modules: libcudnn.so.8 -> /opt/cudnn/8.6/lib

Marta: That confirms host image mismatch. I'll open infra ticket to roll compatible cudnn or update image digest since drivers are older.

Alex: Perfect — action items: 1) Block PR (Alex), 2) Infra ticket (Marta), 3) Bisect images if infra changes don't fix (Dmitri). Thanks all.

Sam: FYI I added a short smoke that checks cuDNN reported version pre-warmup to catch this earlier.

Jess: Nice. :eyes:
